seed_note: The endpoint takes no seed (its input schema has none). Reproducibility is prompt + reference frames + model + params, recorded here; a rerun gives a different image with the same brief.
style: Same art style as the reference frames, which are the locked seed: sumi-e ink wash on warm paper, flat fills, palette limited to paper-cream, mist-pale, wash greys and ink-black. Third-person follow view from slightly above and behind a small traveller in a straw hat. COMPOSITION (STYLE-BIBLE section 5, mandatory): a dark near-vertical cliff mass fills the LEFT side of the frame with vertical fracture lines; a bright cloud-sea void fills the RIGHT side; the walkable path is the narrow lighter ledge on the seam between them, with a defined dark edge where it meets the void. Horizon high, void fills the lower-right. Cliff tops flat, faces near-vertical, no rounded rock. Torii are vermilion post-and-lintel gates placed in sequence along the path as waypoints; vermilion appears on the torii and nowhere else. Crows are ink-black, never coloured. No floating platforms: every ledge is attached to the cliff. No text, no UI, no light source, no cast shadows. Birds: none anywhere unless the segment text asks for one crow; never a bird in flight.

segments.seg1-ground-jump: Segment 1 of the first chapter, 'The Lower Stair'. No birds. In the foreground the path is a wide flat ledge at the cliff base, on the seam. Midground: a SHORT straight stone stair of about five steps rises along the cliff face to a higher ledge. Beyond the stair the higher ledge is clearly broken by two separate small gaps that open onto the void below (the ledge simply stops and resumes a short jump later, the second gap a little wider than the first). Every ledge piece stays attached to the cliff on the left. A vermilion torii stands on the ledge after the second gap.
segments.seg2-climb: Segment 2. No birds. NO stairs in this segment. A vermilion torii stands just behind the traveller on a flat ledge. Ahead, the ledge runs to the foot of a sheer rock step in the cliff: a flat vertical face about twice a person's height, with a flat ledge on top; a short way along that ledge, a second sheer face of the same height, again with a flat top. Two tall blocky steps of bare rock, climbed by hand, like a giant two-step stair carved by fracture, all attached to the cliff mass on the left. On the top ledge a vermilion torii stands silhouetted against the bright void on the right.
segments.seg3-crow: Segment 3. A long level ledge on the seam. Partway along it a heavy dark stone slab slides out of the cliff face, straight across the path and over the edge into the void, then back into the cliff, like a piston. Just before the slab, a single black crow is perched on a knob of the cliff face, clearly visible against the pale wall above the path. The traveller stands at a vermilion torii, waiting. A second vermilion torii stands on the ledge beyond the slab.
segments.seg4-crow-jump-climb: Segment 4, the last of the chapter. FRAME LAYOUT: the dark cliff wall occupies the whole left half of the frame from bottom edge to top edge and never ends; the right half is bright cloud-sea void with nothing standing in it (no pillar, no stack, no island, no bridge, no platform). The path is one narrow ledge running along the base of that wall, receding into the distance. Along it, in order: the traveller in the foreground; a short gap where the ledge breaks and resumes; just past the gap a dark stone slab protruding sideways out of the wall across the ledge; one black crow perched on a knob of the wall beside the gap; further on, the ledge meets a sheer rock step about twice a person's height cut into the same wall; on top of that step, still against the wall, exactly one vermilion torii. Only one torii in the image.
